title: Telemetry
intro: What the switches, routers and firewalls report themselves: SNMP, traps, gNMI, Cisco model-driven telemetry, NX-API, RESTCONF and the OPNsense API, collected by Telegraf on the local agent. Set devices up in the inventory: turn on Telemetry for a device, a group or a tag, and store its SNMP or API login there.
empty: No devices yet. Turn on Telemetry for the core, the switches and the firewalls in the inventory (on a group, it counts for every device in it).
senders: Telegraf, and a firewall's own Telegraf (OPNsense os-telegraf, the pfSense Telegraf package), send with this token. Point an InfluxDB output at /api/telemetry with the token (InfluxDB v2: token; v1: as the password), or at the local agent.
newTokenQuestion: Make a new token? Senders with the old one stop until they get the new one.
pasteIntro: Paste this on the device so it sends to the collector. Fill in the parts in angle brackets.
pasteNothing: Nothing to set up on the device for these drivers: the collector asks it.

problem.refused: {{driver}}: nothing listens on {{address}}. Is it turned on on the device, and the port right?
problem.timeout: {{driver}}: no answer from {{address}}. Is it reachable from the agent, and the port right?
problem.timeout_snmp: SNMP: no answer from {{address}}. Check the community or SNMPv3 login, and that an ACL lets the agent in.
problem.timeout_vlan: SNMP: no answer from {{address}} for VLAN {{vlan}} (community@{{vlan}}). If its other data comes in, the switch doesn't have that VLAN (fix telemetry_vlans), or the SNMPv3 user may not read vlan- contexts.
problem.timeout_table: SNMP: no answer from {{address}} while reading {{table}}. If its other data comes in, the walk is too slow (a big table or SNMP rate limit); otherwise check the login and ACL.
problem.auth: {{driver}}: {{address}} refused the login. Check the user and password (or SNMPv3 keys).
problem.unreachable: {{driver}}: the agent has no route to {{address}}. Check the address and the agent's network.
problem.tls: {{driver}}: TLS with {{address}} failed. Check its certificate, or turn off TLS checking for it.
problem.listen: {{driver}}: Telegraf cannot open its listening port. Is another program using it?
